reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, sku
FROM products
WHERE sku <> TRIM(sku)
alternatives: SELECT product_id, sku FROM products WHERE sku LIKE ' %' OR sku LIKE '% '
SELECT product_id, sku FROM products WHERE length(sku) <> length(TRIM(sku))

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, sku FROM products WHERE sku LIKE ' %' OR sku LIKE '% '
other_way.tradeoff: Two LIKE patterns read plainly, but comparing the sku with TRIM(sku) covers both ends in one test.
